title: Waste item classification
description: What a waste item is: a free-text description, its EWC codes, and whether it contains persistent organic pollutants (POPs). All three are required. Whether the waste is hazardous comes from its EWC codes.

wasteDescription.description: A free-text description of the waste. An empty string is treated as not provided.

items.description: A European Waste Catalogue (EWC) code: six digits, with no spaces. Only the format is checked here; the service also checks the code is one of those served by GET /reference-data/ewc-codes, which is too long a list to inline, and reports an unrecognised code as an InvalidValue error.

ewcCodes.description: The EWC codes that describe the waste: at least one, and up to five to allow for dual and mirror codes. Each must be six digits and a code from GET /reference-data/ewc-codes; the service checks the second.

pops.description: Whether the waste item contains persistent organic pollutants, and if so which. Required, even when there are none.
